description: Product metrics for Trackly including user activity, track uploads, and feature usage

panels.title: Tracks Uploaded (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Total number of tracks uploaded in the last 24 hours.

**Why**: Primary product health metric.

**Actions**: Compare with previous days to identify trends.

panels.title: Tracks Uploaded (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Total number of tracks uploaded in the last 7 days.

**Why**: Weekly view smooths daily fluctuations.

**Actions**: Compare week-over-week for growth trends.

panels.title: Deduplicated (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Number of tracks identified as duplicates in the last 24h.

**Why**: High deduplication rates may indicate user confusion or re-uploads.

**Actions**: If >20%, investigate why users upload duplicates.

panels.title: Upload Failures (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Number of failed track uploads in the last 24h.

**Why**: Upload failures directly impact user experience.

**Targets**: 0 (no failures) | 1-5 (warning) | >5 (critical).

**Actions**: Check backend logs for error patterns.

panels.title: Tracks Deleted (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Number of tracks deleted by users in the last 24h.

**Why**: Deletion rate can indicate dissatisfaction or cleanup behavior.

**Actions**: High deletion rates may indicate users cannot find or manage their tracks.

panels.title: Upload Success Rate
panels.description:
**What**: Percentage of upload attempts that succeeded.

**Why**: Core reliability metric.

**Targets**: >95% (good) | 90-95% (warning) | <90% (critical).

**Actions**: If low, check upload failure reasons.

panels.title: Track Upload Activity Over Time
panels.description:
**What**: Upload, deduplication, and failure rates over time.

**Why**: Trends reveal patterns in user behavior and system health.

**Actions**: Look for correlation between spikes and deployments.

panels.title: Tracks by Source (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Upload breakdown by source (web, mobile, API).

**Why**: Shows which platforms drive usage.

**Actions**: Low mobile usage may indicate mobile UX issues.

panels.title: Track Length Distribution (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Distribution of track lengths uploaded in the last 24h.

**Why**: Understanding the length distribution helps identify typical use cases (short walks vs long hikes).

**Actions**: Most tracks should fall in expected length ranges. Unexpected spikes may indicate data quality issues.

panels.title: Track Categories (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Distribution of track categories (hiking, walking, running, cycling).

**Why**: Shows which activities are most popular.

**Actions**: Focus marketing on dominant categories.

panels.title: Elevation Enrichments (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Successful elevation enrichment requests in 24h.

**Why**: Elevation adds value to tracks.

**Actions**: Low adoption may indicate feature discovery issues.

panels.title: POIs Created (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: POIs created automatically in 24h.

**Why**: POIs enrich the map experience.

**Actions**: If 0 during active uploads, check POI detection logic.

panels.title: POIs Deleted/Unlinked (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: POIs deleted or unlinked in 24h.

**Why**: Cleanup activity.

**Actions**: High deletion rates may indicate over-creation or bugs.

panels.title: Elevation Success Rate
panels.description:
**What**: Percentage of elevation enrichment requests that succeeded.

**Why**: External API dependency.

**Targets**: >70% (good) | 50-70% (warning) | <50% (critical).

**Actions**: If low, check external API status.

panels.title: Elevation Enrichment Activity
panels.description:
**What**: Elevation enrichment request rate by status.

**Why**: Shows enrichment volume and success patterns.

**Actions**: Spikes in failed status need investigation.

panels.title: POI Activity
panels.description:
**What**: POI creation and deletion rates by source.

**Why**: Shows POI lifecycle.

**Actions**: Healthy systems have balanced create/delete ratios.

panels.title: Top 10 API Endpoints by Request Rate
panels.description:
**What**: Top 10 API endpoints by request rate.

**Why**: Identifies most-used features.

**Actions**: Optimize performance for high-traffic endpoints.

panels.title: Endpoint Usage Summary (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Total requests per endpoint in 24h.

**Why**: Usage patterns and API health.

**Actions**: Zero usage on key endpoints may indicate broken clients.

panels.title: Track Exports by Format
panels.description:
**What**: Track export operations by format (GPX, KML, etc).

**Why**: Shows which formats users prefer.

**Actions**: Deprioritize unused formats, improve popular ones.

panels.title: Total Exports (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Total track exports in 24h.

**Why**: Indicates user engagement with their data.

**Actions**: Growth here suggests healthy engagement.

panels.title: Upload Failures by Reason (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Upload failure breakdown by reason.

**Why**: Identifies common failure modes.

**Actions**: Address the most common failure reason first.

Zero-Result Rate (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Percentage of searches that returned no results.

**Why**: Zero-result searches indicate content gaps.

**Targets**: <10% (good) | 10-20% (warning) | >20% (critical).

**Actions**: Improve search relevance or content coverage.

panels.title: Track Edits (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Track edits (name, description, categories) in 7d.

**Why**: Shows user investment in their content.

**Actions**: Growth here suggests healthy engagement.

panels.title: Track Exports (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Track exports in the last 7 days.

**Why**: Longer-term engagement view.

**Actions**: Track week-over-week trends.

panels.title: Map Interactions (24h)
panels.description:
**What**: Map interactions (pan, zoom, etc) in 24h.

**Why**: Indicates map feature usage.

**Actions**: Low usage may indicate map UX issues.

Map Interactions (7d)

**What**: Map interactions in the last 7 days.

**Why**: Weekly engagement view.

**Actions**: Compare week-over-week.

panels.title: Engagement Score (per session, 7d)
panels.description:
**What**: Engagement score per session (7d).

**Why**: Composite engagement metric.

**Actions**: Track trends and correlate with product changes.
View-to-Upload Ratio (7d). Target >2.0 (green), Warning <1.5 (yellow), Critical <1.0 (red).

Funnel: Upload → View → Enrich → Export → Edit → Delete (7d)
panels.description:
**What**: User engagement funnel showing absolute counts for each stage (7d).

**Why**: Funnels help identify where users drop off in the product journey.

**Stages**: Upload, View, Enrich, Export, Edit, Delete.

**Actions**: If drop-off is high between stages, investigate UX friction at that point.
